title: My work
intro: Projects running in production, and exercises owned as such. wikiwa is the one I operate day to day; the others mark out the career change, from training through to my first assignments.

wikiwa.title: wikiwa.com
wikiwa.description: TV series recommendation platform, live in production
wikiwa.descriptionLong: A product I design, build, deploy and operate single-handedly, as a self-employed developer. Collaborative filtering recommendation engine, TheTVDB API integration, user accounts, dashboard and multi-criteria sorting. Server-side rendering for search indexing and social link previews, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, GDPR compliance, and continuous deployment through GitHub Actions onto a Docker VPS. Phased rollout through successive closed beta groups, with fixes driven by user feedback.

lignes.title: Lignes Éternelles
lignes.descriptionLong: Website developed to present the professional activity of a local artist and allow contact. Created with particular attention to accessibility and eco-design.

creation.title: Freelance website
creation.description: Showcase of my web development work
creation.descriptionLong: A website I designed to present my work and services. I enjoy building my own projects to learn and experiment, while staying focused on what matters: clarity and efficiency.

shinefulness.title: Shinefulness®
shinefulness.descriptionLong: SPA application in Vue.js and Laravel API based on 'Le théorème du bien-être' (O. Soria). Generates PDF roadmaps, statistics, mailing, and accessible user experience. Long-term CDA project with clean architecture, design patterns, and secure authentication (Sanctum).

pepe.title: Pépé la boulange
pepe.description: Showcase website and artisan order interface
pepe.descriptionLong: Full stack site developed for a bakery in Tarn, with admin area, product management, and online ordering. Built with Laravel and Vue.js for autonomous client management.

plantes.title: Révisions2Plantes
plantes.descriptionLong: Application designed in Vue.js for market gardening students. Offers cards, flashcard mode, and quizzes with scoring. Designed to help memorize ornamental, weed, and unwanted plants.

simpsons.title: Simpsons Fight
simpsons.descriptionLong: Game inspired by the Simpsons universe: turn-based combat between a random team and the alien Kang. Built with Angular, dynamic animations, and simple RPG game logic.

puissance4.title: Connect 4
puissance4.descriptionLong: Developed in OOP JavaScript, this game features complete win detection logic, player customization, dynamic grid, and multi-round mode with score objectives.
